summary: Electrovaya Inc., a Canadian lithium-ion battery maker, filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the launch of its ElvaPulse 1500 high-power stationary battery energy storage platform for data centers and AI infrastructure. The product offers up to 2.88 MWh energy and 7 MW continuous power, with initial deliveries targeted for Q2 2027 from its Jamestown, NY facility. The filing is purely a product launch announcement with no financial terms, strategic review, or corporate transaction. No special-situation elements (merger, tender, activist, restructuring) are present; it is a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer.
